text: A muscular male figure with a dark brown skin tone stands center-frame. He wears a black loincloth with three yellow circles. His head is covered by a black mask with horn-like protrusions; no hair visible. Face shape is angular, mouth open in a roar. Arms are raised high, hands gripping unseen structures. Background shows purple-hued stone walls and greenish light behind him. No other figures are clearly visible.
